name: com.jacksonzane.twicetold-npc
description: Unity client for the twicetold-npc long-memory NPC service: an engine-agnostic C# core (NpcMemoryClient, NpcSession, wire models) plus a thin MonoBehaviour adapter. Provision an agent, observe gameplay, stream dialogue, correct the record, and close scenes against a self-hosted backend.

samples.description: The thirty-line integration from docs/first-npc.md, plus the link.xml that IL2CPP builds need.
